cats.d: How much he scores and how efficiently
Three-point and free-throw shooting, adjusted for volume
Creating shots for himself and for teammates
Steals and box-score defense (no tracking data)
All-in-one impact: how much better his team is with him

pts75.d: Points he scores per 75 possessions he's on the floor (about one full game).

ts.d: Scoring efficiency that counts 3s as worth more and includes free throws.

rts.d: True shooting compared with the league average that season, in percentage points.
rts.x: Player TS% − league TS% (league = total points ÷ 2 × (FGA + 0.44 × FTA) over every player).

rim_fg.d: How often his shots within 3 feet go in, volume-adjusted.
rim_fg.x: (rim makes + 50 × league rim FG%) ÷ (rim attempts + 50). Rim attempts = FGA × share of FGA from 0-3 ft (Basketball-Reference shooting).

rim_rate.d: Share of his shots taken within 3 feet of the rim. A style number, not graded.

fg3.d: Three-point percentage, pulled toward league average when he takes few threes.
fg3.x: (3PM + 100 × league 3P%) ÷ (3PA + 100). The raw 3P% shows in the tooltip.

fg3r.d: Share of his shots that are threes. A style number, not graded.

corner3.d: Share of his threes taken from the corners (the shortest three). A style number, not graded.

ft.d: Free-throw percentage, volume-adjusted. A strong signal of shooting touch.

sce75.d: Baskets he creates per 75 possessions: his own unassisted makes plus the makes he assists.
sce75.x: (unassisted 2PM + unassisted 3PM + AST) per 100 possessions × 0.75. Unassisted = FGM × (1 − share assisted), Basketball-Reference shooting.

load.d: How much of the offense runs through him: the average of his usage rate and assist rate.

ast.d: Share of teammates' baskets he assists while on the floor.

unast.d: Share of his own made shots that nobody assisted.

tov.d: Turnovers per 100 plays he uses. Lower is better, so the bar is flipped.
tov.x: Basketball-Reference turnover percentage: TOV ÷ (FGA + 0.44 × FTA + TOV).

stl.d: Share of opponent possessions that end with his steal while he's on the floor.

dbpm.d: The defensive half of box plus/minus. The box score misses a lot of defense, so treat it as rough.
dbpm.x: Basketball-Reference DBPM (points per 100 possessions vs an average player).

dws48.d: Defensive win shares per 48 minutes. Leans heavily on team defense.

drtg.d: Points allowed per 100 possessions, Dean Oliver's individual estimate. Lower is better.

blk.d: Share of opponent two-point attempts he blocks while on the floor. This is shot blocking, not full rim protection.

drb.d: Share of available defensive rebounds he grabs.

orb.d: Share of available offensive rebounds he grabs.

bpm.d: Points per 100 possessions he adds compared with an average player, estimated from the box score.

onoff.d: How many points per 100 possessions better his team was with him on the court than off it. Noisy.
onoff.x: Team net rating on court − off court (Basketball-Reference play-by-play).

vorp.d: BPM turned into a season total, so it rewards playing lots of minutes. Shown, not graded.

off: Primary Creator
AST% ≥ 28 and USG% ≥ 20: runs the offense and sets up teammates.
Go-To Scorer
USG% ≥ 28 (and not a Primary Creator): the offense's first scoring option.
Secondary Handler
AST% ≥ 18 and USG% ≥ 18: a second ball handler who can run some offense.
Connector
AST% ≥ 20 with USG% under 18: a low-usage passer who keeps the ball moving.
Interior Scorer
Big (position estimate ≥ 3.6), USG% ≥ 21 and 3PAr < .25: scores inside on volume.
Rim Runner
Rim rate ≥ 45% and 3PAr < .15: finishes lobs, rolls and putbacks.
Stretch Big
Big (position estimate ≥ 4.0) and 3PAr ≥ .30: a big who spaces the floor.
Spot-Up Shooter
3PAr ≥ .45 and at least 80% of his made threes assisted: catch-and-shoot spacing.
Slasher
Guard or wing (position estimate < 3.6), rim rate ≥ 30% and USG% ≥ 18: attacks the basket off the dribble or cuts.
Play Finisher
Everyone else: plays off the ball and finishes what others create.
def: Big (position estimate ≥ 3.6) with DRB% ≥ 24: ends possessions on the glass.
STL% ≥ 1.5, BLK% ≥ 1.8 and DBPM ≥ 0.5: defends in space and at the rim.
STL% ≥ 2.3: forces turnovers at the point of attack and in passing lanes.
Wing or big (position estimate ≥ 2.4) with DRB% ≥ 22.
Big (position estimate ≥ 3.6) who doesn't meet the bars above.
Everyone else: a team defender on the perimeter.

meta.score: Category score = weighted average of the graded metrics' percentiles in that category, re-ranked 0-99 against every qualified player (or every player in his position group when 'vs position' is on). Style numbers (weight 0) are shown but not graded.
meta.src: Basketball-Reference season pages (advanced, per 100 possessions, shooting, play-by-play). Metrics, percentiles, roles and scores by Spreadsheet Sports.
